calculation_handling.description: Any part of a building or structure that is permitted to encroach into a required minimum building setback under Clause 10.5.40.60 is not counted in lot coverage.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the footprint of the permitted encroaching parts.

calculation_handling.description: A platform without main walls, and any roof or canopy above it, is not counted in lot coverage if it is attached to, or less than 0.3 metres from, a building and does not encroach into a required setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the platform footprint and its distance from the building.

calculation_handling.description: The platform exclusion from lot coverage applies only if the lot area covered by these structures is no more than 5% of the lot area.

10.5.30.40(1).explanation: Parts of a building or structure that are permitted to encroach into a required setback do not count toward lot coverage.

10.5.30.40(2).explanation: A deck, porch, balcony or similar platform without main walls, and any roof above it, does not count toward lot coverage if it is attached to or within 0.3 metres of a building and covers no more than 5% of the lot area.
